input.prompt: Add a Redis-backed rate limiter to the API server and make it fail open when Redis is unavailable.

decisions.title: What should the API do when Redis is unavailable?

sentences.text: The agent added a Redis-backed rate limiter as new middleware and wired it into the server app.
You chose to fail open, so requests keep flowing when Redis is down.
The latest test run has 14 passing tests and 1 failing test.
